locomotion.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: precise production-ready transparent 2D RTS sprite atlas, locomotion animation for latticeSkiff. Input image is a DESIGN IDENTITY reference only. Preserve recognizable full unit silhouette, materials, geometry, asymmetric equipment and palette. Generate genuinely new painted articulated animation frames. Remove all reference background/card borders. No scene.
STRICT EXACT GRID: 10 COLUMNS x 8 ROWS, 80 independent sprites total. Equal square cells each160x160, whole canvas ideally1600x1280. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no outer margins.
CRITICAL GUTTERS: each COMPLETE unit (all nose/lance/wing tips/legs/effects) fits inside 75% of cell width and 80% of cell height. Each cell MUST have at least 12% width CLEAR TRANSPARENT gutter on left and right and 10% height gutter above and below. Never overlap adjacent cells. No intercell haze. Fit the entire long lance/pointed prow INSIDE each cell, even side-view frames. Smaller complete unit is better than clipped weapon. Stable center anchor, identical scale across all frames, no whole-frame translation/scaling.
Detailed painted non-pixel science fiction, overhead three-quarter fixed 35 degree downward camera, high-contrast readable miniature art. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard.
Row1=NORTH, backside/rear visible, pointed nose/lance UP toward top of screen. Row2=NORTHEAST rear-right view, nose/lance UP-RIGHT. Row3=EAST right side profile, nose/lance points exactly RIGHT. Row4=SOUTHEAST front-right view, nose/lance DOWN-RIGHT. Row5=SOUTH front view, nose/lance points exactly DOWN toward bottom/viewer. Row6=SOUTHWEST front-left view, nose/lance DOWN-LEFT. Row7=WEST left side profile, nose/lance exactly LEFT. Row8=NORTHWEST rear-left view, nose/lance UP-LEFT. These are actual 3D object orientations under one fixed overhead/three-quarter camera, not simply repeating the source front view. Back views must show rear plating/engines and weapons pointing away, different from front.
Within EACH row columns1-4 are FOUR IDLE poses with visible distinct mechanical/lattice energy movement, columns5-10 are SIX ACTUAL MOVE poses. The movement poses must be different mechanical limb/control component positions, stable unit body anchor. No whole-body image shifts or scale tricks.
Lattice Skiff: a sleek white-ivory and gold winged flying transport with clearly pointed gold prow and a large upright central purple crystal suspended inside horizontal gold lattice rings. Preserve white hull fins, purple canopy/crystals and gold ring geometry. It has no legs. Idle rings shift and crystal pulses. Moving rings genuinely rotate, wing control surfaces articulate and aft purple thruster flames vary. Attack is restrained purple pulse emission from the prow with a ring charging, pulse firing, slight energy recoil and reset. Hit shows crystal/rings shudder with small purple shield sparks. Death shows crystal fracture, breaking rings, hull folding, lower gold/ivory fragmented wreck, scattered debris. Special ability opens a coherent purple transport conduit inside its lattice rings.
Every one of 80 sprites required. Preserve exactly 10 columns, all8rows, with clear gutters. No extra frames, no omissions, no cropped limbs, no background rectangles. This sheet is directly sliced on its EXACT evenly spaced grid.
